packageRules.description: Swiss Ephemeris is the source of every number this app produces. An upgrade can shift positions and repack the .se1 files, which invalidates the pinned SHA-256 digests in src/ephemeris/assets.ts and the generated constants. Never automatic; always a deliberate review against the golden-chart gate.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** run `npm run ephe:sync` (expect digest failures if upstream repacked), `node scripts/gen-constants.mjs`, and `npm test`. The golden-chart gate must stay green at its historical tolerance of 0.2 arcseconds.

packageRules.description: typescript-eslint gates which TypeScript version is usable: TS is pinned to the newest release its peer range accepts. Group them so the toolchain moves as one unit.
Dev tooling patch and minor updates are safe to automerge once the check suite passes.
